courses.title: Heal Your Voice Collection
courses.description: Francie's self-paced bundle of voice work: the Heal Your Voice course, Sacred Sounds: Mantra as Medicine, the monthly Vocal Flow practice library, the seven-day Sing Your Heart Open, guided audios and a songbook, with lifetime access. Built for anyone wanting to sing or speak more freely, trained or not.

courses.title: Compassionate Inquiry Sessions
courses.description: One-to-one sessions in Gabor Maté's Compassionate Inquiry approach, online or in person, exploring the patterns, beliefs and body sensations beneath stress, overwhelm and old wounds. Offered as a four-session journey or monthly.
courses.price: $500 USD for four sessions, or $150 USD a month
